heading: 4.0 Participant characteristics
objective: The study comprised 85 participants with recorded operative findings and evaluable histopathology. This report describes their demographic and baseline clinical profile.
methods: Continuous variables are summarised by the mean and standard deviation (SD), median and first and third quartiles (Q1–Q3). Categorical variables are presented as counts and percentages of valid responses. No demographic hypothesis tests were performed because these summaries describe the study population.
finalParagraph: The cohort was predominantly young and student-based, with nearly equal numbers of males and females. All participants had evaluable histopathology, but only eight were reference-negative. This clinical composition limits the precision and generalisability of diagnostic subgroup estimates.
